name: tetra-ui
summary: Copy-paste React Native components installed with the shadcn CLI, built for Expo and styled with Uniwind.
description: shadcn/ui-style components for React Native, copied into your project rather than imported: npx shadcn@latest add @tetra-ui/<component> pulls from the registry published at tetra-ui.com/r/<name>.json. Requires React 19, the React Native New Architecture and Uniwind (Tailwind for React Native), Expo recommended. Includes 30+ components such as accordion, alert, bottom sheet, carousel, form, menu, OTP input, popover, segmented control, select, slider, switch and toast. Dark mode comes from CSS variable theme tokens, and llms.txt, llms-full.txt and AGENTS.md support AI agents. MIT licensed.
